title: Expenses content in a veyq-subtree manifest
description: The `content` of an Expenses node in a download (ADR 0082, ADR 0108, docs/apps/expenses.md § Download and import): what the envelope, core's ../veyq-subtree.schema.json, leaves opaque. A content of `type` `expenses.pot` is this; Expenses' own `validatePotContent` (src/web/src/features/expenses/exportImport.ts) checks it before an import writes anything, its caps pinned to this file by that module's test. Payloads are core's shape (`payload` in the envelope); an entry is the plaintext of the entry format, ../../expenses/entry.v1.schema.json.

pot.description: Expenses: the content of an EXPENSES_POT node (docs/apps/expenses.md § Download and import) - its settings, its people, the current revision of each live entry, in the plaintext of the entry format (contracts/expenses/entry.v1.schema.json), and the receipts that revision holds, each a payload. History is not exported, nor are deleted entries or dropped receipts: an import uploads each receipt under a new id before the revision that lists it and starts each entry at its current revision, under ids it mints, mapping every reference below. Ids here are the Pot's own and mean nothing in another instance.

categories.description: The Pot's own categories, beside the default set; an entry names one by its id.

tenantId.description: The tenant whose members the participants' `memberId`s are, the exporting member's; present exactly when one carries a `memberId`. An import into this same tenant keeps each member, an import anywhere else makes each the name sealed with it (ADR 0108 decision 2).

participants.description: Every participant of the Pot that is not removed. A deleted one (its name erased, ADR 0108 decision 3) carries `deleted: true` and no name.

table.description: The entries as a CSV for a spreadsheet, beside the manifest. For reading only: an import ignores it.

memberId.description: The participant is this member of the content's `tenantId` (ADR 0108 decision 2); its `name` is the display name sealed at adding. Only in a member's download (a link guest's names no tenant), never on a deleted one, and no member twice.

receipts.description: The receipts the entry's current revision holds, each with its bytes: exactly the ids its `entry.receipts` lists, each once. A receipt the download cannot read - one the operator blocked - is left out of both. Absent: none.

entry.description: The entry's current revision without `v` and `heads`, which an import writes anew.

receipt.description: One receipt (uc.expenses.attach-receipts): its id, which the entry's `receipts` lists, its file name and its bytes. The name and the type are what its sealed blob meta said, opened on the exporting device; the server never saw either.

name.description: The receipt's own file name (the archive path may be a safe or numbered form of it).

file.description: The receipt's plaintext, at most 10 MiB (the receipt role's cap). Its `mediaType` is the sealed type, empty where none was sealed; an import takes only an image or `application/pdf` by that type or, without one, by the name's extension (the picker's rule), and refuses anything else before writing.
